title: passage
description: One line of research/passages.jsonl (Implementation Decision 17; tickets 86, 93, and 88): a piece of a section's text with who contributed it, written only by code through the ledger. A ticket's Results passage is a finding in findings.jsonl, so only an inherited passage (by a document), the owner's, or a consolidation's names Results.

section.description: results only for an inherited passage (by a document), the owner's, or a consolidation's

heading.description: the heading it stands under in its section

text.description: Markdown with LaTeX math, from one claim to a paragraph; a claim sentence ends with its provenance tag

replaces.description: the passage of the same section this one replaces, which then leaves the rendered file and stays here; in Results, a finding or an inherited Results passage

by.description: who contributed it: a ticket's attempt (t3-a1), the owner, a document, a front-door step (step:position, step:specify), an answered objective, or a consolidation

objectives.description: the objectives of the ticket that wrote it; empty for one no objective asked for

ticket.description: the ticket that wrote it, or null

wave.description: the conductor's wave it was integrated in (run and number), or null outside a run; two replacements of one passage in the same wave are both kept

evidence.description: on a passage replacing an inherited claim: whether this project's evidence supports, narrows, or contradicts it

doc.description: an inherited passage's locator in its document's text.md: the block, and the sentence or run of sentences (D1#p4.s2, D1#p4.s1-s3, D1#p6)

standing.description: an inherited claim's standing: unchecked until a passage or finding replaces it with evidence, or unverifiable with its reason

reason.description: why an unverifiable claim could not be checked; on a passage replacing an owner's passage, the stated reason its evidence overrides it (ticket 88)

replaces_owner.description: on a passage replacing an owner's passage, by anyone but the owner: journaled for the account, which lists it under "Changed without asking you" (ticket 88)

withdrawn.description: a withdrawal: it takes the passage it replaces out of the section, its text kept here as it stood

moved_from.description: the inherited passage, in another section, this one was moved from; a withdrawal there takes it out
